cover.alt: Her project cover: a glitched close-up of leaf veins, pink-red leaf between dark green veins, with grey pixel blocks and a band of colour noise along the bottom.

moodboard.alt: Her inspiration and silhouette board: a collage of a giant leaf, mushrooms, Venus flytraps, moss, an uncanny face, gowns, an oversized knit and ruffled, layered fabrics, with four Pantone chips and her labels.

inspiration.alt: The INSPIRATION half of her board: a giant leaf, mushrooms, Venus flytraps, moss, curling green tendrils, pink and brown organic textures and an uncanny face, labelled ominous, raw, textures, earthy and uncanny, with four Pantone chips.

silhouette.alt: The SILHOUTTE half of her board: a strapless pink bodycon gown, an oversized ribbed turtleneck, a pink gown seen from the back, layered rough-edged fabric, pink ruffles, green wavy patchwork and two flytrap embellishments, each labelled.

heading-inspiration.alt: INSPIRATION, her lettering in red on a white paper strip.

heading-silhouette.alt: SILHOUTTE, her lettering in red on a white paper strip.

chip-yellow.alt: Pantone chip 13-0544 TCX, a warm yellow.

chip-green.alt: Pantone chip 16-0299 TCX, a dark moss green.

chip-olive.alt: Pantone chip 19-0220 TCX, an olive yellow.

chip-pink.alt: Pantone chip 13-2120 TCX, a soft pink.

leaf.alt: A giant leaf seen from above, grey-green cells between pale yellow veins, labelled ominous.

mushrooms.alt: Pale mushroom caps seen from below, their fine gills fanning out.

face.alt: A pale, uncanny face tucked inside a green pod, pink tendrils curling over it.

embellishment.alt: Two Venus flytraps used as embellishments: green, spiky-edged, with dark red centres.

lineup.alt: Her line-up of eleven illustrated looks in pink and lime green: ruffled seams, stripes, cropped turtlenecks, long sleeves, wide trousers, draped and wrap skirts and column dresses, with small flower embellishments.

lineup-1.alt: Look 1 of her line-up: a lime cropped turtleneck with pink ruffled sleeves over a long lime skirt with pink side panels.

lineup-2.alt: Look 2: a one-shoulder column gown in pink and green stripes with ruffled seams and small flowers.

lineup-3.alt: Look 3: a lime cropped turtleneck with pink sleeves and wide lime trousers with ruffled green seams and flowers.

lineup-4.alt: Look 4: a striped pink top with one long sleeve and a green and pink draped wrap skirt knotted with a flower.

lineup-5.alt: Look 5: a striped cropped turtleneck with long sleeves and a long pink and green striped skirt with flowers.

lineup-6.alt: Look 6: a pink ruffled turtleneck top, belted with a flower, over an asymmetric pink and green ruffled skirt.

lineup-7.alt: Look 7: a pink one-shoulder crop top with a long green drape and a green wrapped skirt with a high slit.

lineup-8.alt: Look 8: a pink ruffled cropped turtleneck with full sleeves and wide lime trousers with ruffled edges and flowers.

lineup-9.alt: Look 9: a striped strapless top and a tiered pink and green ruffled wrap skirt with flowers.

lineup-10.alt: Look 10: a striped cropped turtleneck with ruffled sleeves and a long pink skirt with green ruffled stripes.

lineup-11.alt: Look 11: a sleeveless high-neck column dress in pink and green vertical stripes.

tab-projects.alt: PROJECTS, her lettering on a yellow tab.

flap-project-01.alt: PROJECT 01, her lettering on a yellow corner flap.

look-1.alt: Final look, front and back: a cropped turtleneck in mustard and olive knit with long ruffled sleeves, over a long skirt of olive, green and pink ribbed stripes.

look-1-front.alt: Final look from the front: a cropped knit turtleneck with ruffled sleeves and a long striped rib-knit skirt with small flowers.

look-1-back.alt: Final look from the back: the cropped turtleneck leaves the waist bare above the long striped skirt.

look-2.alt: Final look, front and back: a strapless column dress in olive, green and pink ribbed stripes with ruffled seams and small flower embellishments.

look-2-front.alt: Strapless striped column dress from the front, with small flowers.

look-2-back.alt: Strapless striped column dress from the back.

makeup-eyes.alt: Makeup reference: eyes rimmed in red with lime-green brows and streaks.

makeup-face.alt: Makeup reference: a face with red-rimmed eyes, lime brows, glossy red and gold lips, and Venus flytraps worn in the hair like ears.

makeup-hair.alt: Hair reference: dark hair seen from above with Venus flytraps tucked in at the sides.

photo-1.alt: Night shoot: the strapless striped rib-knit dress with ruffled seams and small flowers, worn in tall grass.

photo-2.alt: Night shoot: close-up of the striped knit and a ruffled sleeve.

photo-3.alt: Night shoot: looking back over the shoulder in the ribbed turtleneck, its waffle-knit and rib panels edged with pink stitching and ruffles.

photo-4.alt: Night shoot: the cropped waffle-knit turtleneck with ruffled sleeves over the striped rib-knit skirt with flowers.

photo-5.alt: Night shoot: close-up of the makeup, lime eyeshadow and red-rimmed eyes, chin tucked into the green turtleneck.

photo-6.alt: Night shoot: portrait in the turtleneck, small in the lower right of a dark frame.

backdrop-left.alt: A blown-up, cool-toned print from the night shoot behind the photos: the cropped turtleneck and striped skirt.

backdrop-right.alt: A blown-up print from the night shoot behind the photos: the striped rib knit with a flower embellishment.

fabric-waffle.alt: Close-up of the waffle knit in mustard and yellow-green, with a green rib-knit band and pink stitched edge.

fabric-stripes.alt: Close-up of the striped knit: mustard, olive green and pink rib panels joined with raw, ruffled seams, with a flower embellishment.

fabric-rib.alt: Close-up of the turtleneck: green rib knit beside mustard and yellow-green knit, edged with pink stitching.
